importantNote: Fixed 3-dot options buttons truncation on playlist and search pages.

items: Converted remote playlist and album track lists from card grids to sleek horizontal rows with visible 3-dot options buttons.

Enforced max-width (calc(100% - 48px)) on track title/artist flex containers so 3-dot buttons (.search-row-opt-btn, .remove-from-pl-btn, .remote-track-opt-btn) are pinned on-screen and never pushed off the viewport edge.
Preserved 100% backend streaming and track menu action sheet functionality.
